description.text: The first enhanced expansion pack of the Sword & Shield series, released on 7 February 2020, in which Rillaboom, Cinderace and Inteleon arrived as Pokémon VMAX; Cinderace VMAX was the first Fire-type Pokémon VMAX. Sandaconda V, Boltund V and Dubwool V join them, with the Supporters Sonia and Milo and Twin Energy, which counts as two Colorless Energy. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 70, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon V and Supporters, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon VMAX and Supporters, and gold Ultra Rare Frosmoth, Big Charm and Twin Energy. In English most of its cards came out in Rebel Clash in May 2020.
